keyEvents.text: Yaya Bojang (Alverca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Benfica. Claudio Echeverri replaces Andreas Schjelderup.
Goal! Benfica 1, Alverca 0. Vangelis Pavlidis (Benfica) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Chiquinho (Alverca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Alverca. Matheus França replaces Figueiredo because of an injury.
Substitution, Alverca. Diogo Spencer replaces Francisco Chissumba.
Ian Luccas (Alverca) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Clément Lenglet (Benfica) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Benfica. Rafa replaces Dodi Lukébakio because of an injury.
